request.prompt: How tall is the Unitree G1?

result.text:
The Unitree G1 humanoid robot stands approximately 1.27 to 1.32 meters (about 4 feet 2 inches to 4 feet 4 inches) tall when fully standing.

For quick reference, here are a few other key physical dimensions of the robot:

Weight: Roughly 35 kg (77 lbs)

Standing Dimensions (H × W × D): 1320×450×200 mm1320 \times 450 \times 200\text{ mm}1320×450×200 mm

Folded Dimensions (for storage/transport): 690×450×300 mm690 \times 450 \times 300\text{ mm}690×450×300 mm
